fix_subject: chore(sdk): revert add GPT-5.5 harness profile (#3160)
what_broke: A model-specific system_prompt_suffix for openai:gpt-5.5 gave only a marginal correctness lift at a latency cost, with solve_rate regressing, so it was reverted before the SDK release.
evidence_quote: harness profile produces a marginal correctness lift (+2pp at medium reasoning, ~0pp at xhigh) at a ~17% latency tax, with `solve_rate` regressing in every cell
replay_notes: Easy: profile is a registered system_prompt_suffix, so run the evals suite on openai:gpt-5.5 at intro^ vs intro; needs many trials because effect is small.

fix_subject: fix(sdk): require a real Nemotron task transition (#6296)
intro_subject: feat(sdk): add NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra harness profile (#4192)
what_broke: The Nemotron policy-nudge middleware searched the whole history for filesystem work, so it sent a conversation-compaction transition nudge in the middle of a single user turn.
evidence_quote: Nemotron Ultra no longer receives a conversation-compaction transition nudge while it is still completing a single user turn.
replay_notes: Moderate: needs Nemotron Ultra access; any multi-step single-turn task with file tool calls then summarization/compaction exercises the spurious nudge.

fix_subject: fix(sdk): enforce full criterion coverage in `RubricMiddleware` (#5234)
what_broke: The rubric grader could return a satisfied verdict with an empty or partial criteria list, ending the self-improve loop with most of a rubric ungraded.
evidence_quote: The grader can return a terminal `satisfied` verdict with an empty or partial `criteria` list, silently ending the self-improve loop with most of the rubric ungraded.
replay_notes: Easy-moderate: run RubricMiddleware with a long (15+ line) rubric and compare criteria coverage reported; bug was latent from the middleware's first commit so intro^ has no middleware.

what_broke: The public eval tool description told the model top-level await will not resolve, contradicting actual REPL behaviour and the system prompt.
evidence_quote: `render_eval_tool_description` said top-level `await` would not resolve, contradicting the REPL behavior and system prompt.
replay_notes: Easy: diff the rendered eval tool description; use a task that needs awaiting an async tool in the REPL and see whether the model avoids await.

fix_subject: fix(quickjs): scope REPL prompt sandbox bullet to the runtime (#3528)
what_broke: The REPL prompt said 'no network, no filesystem' globally while ptc exposed tools.* with web fetch/file/shell access, so the model saw contradictory capability statements.
evidence_quote: A model reading both sections sees "no network" *and* `await tools.webFetch({...})` in the same prompt.
replay_notes: Easy: render system prompt with ptc tools enabled at intro and fix; task requiring a network/file tool called from the REPL.

intro_subject: perf(sdk): count tokens once per model call in summarization middleware (#3877)
what_broke: SummarizationMiddleware retried a failing custom token_counter without tools on any TypeError, silently undercounting so the agent never compacted and overflowed context.
evidence_quote: a `TypeError` raised inside a user-supplied counter ... was silently swallowed and retried in a degraded mode that returned an undercount. The agent would then never compact and overflow the context window
replay_notes: Easy: custom token_counter that raises TypeError on odd tool schemas plus a long-running task; intro identification is by -S on 'except TypeError' (could be older than perf commit).

fix_subject: fix(code): keep server hook state out of task results (#5164)
intro_subject: feat(code): integrate Hooks v2 server lifecycle events (#4997)
what_broke: ServerHooksMiddleware state leaked from subagents into task results, so two parallel `task` completions raised InvalidUpdateError and failed the parent turn.
evidence_quote: Parallel `task` completions no longer crash parent agent turns when server hooks are active.
replay_notes: Easy: run dcode agent at intro and intro^ with a prompt that makes the model call two `task` subagents in parallel.

fix_subject: fix(code): stabilize hook resumes across identity and Command tool results (#5176)
intro_subject: feat(code): integrate Hooks v2 server lifecycle events (#4997)
what_broke: Server-owned hook resumes aborted because the invocation id hashed a run_id that changes on resume and Command-returning tools like `task` failed client re-validation.
evidence_quote: Two defects aborted server-owned hook resumes
replay_notes: Easy-moderate: run dcode with server hooks configured and a task using the `task` tool (Command-returning); PostToolUse hook on resume.

fix_subject: fix(sdk): string interpolation in BaseSandbox write/edit tools (#955)
intro_subject: fix(sdk): handle large payloads and headless container execution (#872)
what_broke: Heredoc write/edit templates in BaseSandbox had {e}/{file_path} placeholders hit by str.format(), raising KeyError so sandbox write/edit tools failed.
evidence_quote: The heredoc-based templates introduced in #872 contain f-string placeholders like {e} and {file_path} that are incorrectly processed by Python's str.format() method, causing KeyError exceptions.
needs_external: docker sandbox or any BaseSandbox backend
replay_notes: Moderate: needs a sandbox backend; any task that writes/edits a file in the sandbox (error path especially).

fix_subject: fix(sdk): preserve CRLF line endings in sandbox edit (#2899)
intro_subject: fix(sdk): use file transfer instead of command strings for sandbox write/edit (#2117)
what_broke: SandboxBackend.edit failed with string_not_found on every CRLF-ending file because edit read raw bytes while the model saw LF-normalised text.
evidence_quote: `SandboxBackend.edit` has deterministically failed with `string_not_found` on every CRLF-ending file since 0.5.0.
needs_external: docker sandbox or any BaseSandbox backend
replay_notes: Moderate: sandbox backend with a CRLF file; ask agent to edit one line.

fix_subject: fix(deepagents): prevent state merge error in parallel sub-agents (#954)
what_broke: Parallel sub-agents with SkillsMiddleware returned skills_metadata to the parent, causing InvalidUpdateError on merge.
evidence_quote: Fixes `InvalidUpdateError` when parallel sub-agents with `SkillsMiddleware` return to parent.
replay_notes: Easy: agent with skills and subagents, prompt that launches two subagents in parallel.

fix_subject: fix(sdk): handle `None` state in messages delta reducer (#3636)
what_broke: The messages delta reducer crashed when DeltaChannel replay passed state=None for threads whose earliest checkpoint never seeded messages.
evidence_quote: `DeltaChannel.replay_writes` can pass `state=None` when a thread's earliest checkpoint never seeded `messages: []`.
replay_notes: Moderate: needs a checkpointed thread resumed through DeltaChannel replay; intro assumed to be the commit that created _messages_reducer.py.

fix_subject: fix(quickjs): run quickjs tests in CI and restore host exception propagation (#3162)
intro_subject: feat(quickjs): surface tool exceptions as the original error (#3049)
what_broke: QuickJS REPL bridge swallowed direct host callback exceptions instead of letting them reach ToolNode; quickjs tests were not running in CI so it was missed.
evidence_quote: restores expected tool-error propagation semantics in the QuickJS REPL bridge
replay_notes: Moderate: PTC tool that raises inside eval; intro commit is a guess among recent _repl.py changes.

fix_subject: fix(deepagents): strip trailing whitespace from subagent messages to prevent Anthropic API errors (#586)
what_broke: Subagent responses with trailing whitespace became the final ToolMessage and the Anthropic API rejected the request.
evidence_quote: final assistant content cannot end with trailing whitespace
replay_notes: Easy with Anthropic key: subagent whose final text ends in whitespace; intro not identified (latent since subagent middleware).
